en.title: lipid injectable emulsion (soybean and olive oils): 2.4, Table 1 and 2.4, Table 1 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.4, Table 1 reads “Birth to 2 years of age”. 2.4, Table 1 reads “2 to less than 12 years of age”. Example: A child aged exactly 2 years matches both rows, with different initial doses. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
